name: Schon Packaging
old_description: A Staple in the Metro Detroit Industrial Packaging Supplies Industry Since 2003
about:
Established in 2003 in Southfield, Michigan, Schon Packaging operates as a privately owned supplier of industrial packaging materials. The company was founded by Larry Schon, who remains the owner and public face of the business, and has served the Metro Detroit region for over two decades.

Schon Packaging sources and distributes a range of bags and protective packaging, including bulk bags, polypropylene bags, polyethylene bags, printed plastic bags, and paper bags. The company also stocks pallet protection items such as chipboard slip sheets, stretch wrap, and pallet covers. Through a network of suppliers and print shops, it offers custom printing up to 10 colors on most bag styles and provides just-in-time, seasonal, and subscription delivery programs to align with customer inventory needs.

The supplier serves customers in the lawn and garden, rubber, and flexible packaging sectors, among other industrial markets. Testimonials on the company’s site reference long-term relationships with buyers in those industries, including a lawn and garden professional who has worked with the firm for 30 years and a rubber industry buyer who relies on the team for inventory management.

Schon Packaging emphasizes relationship-based service, noting that 95 percent of its customers have remained since the start. The company positions its flexibility on minimum order quantities and its ability to leverage a broad supplier network as key differentiators, allowing buyers to avoid excess inventory while maintaining consistent supply.

name: Schulze & Burch
old_description: Trailblazing has been our business since the beginning. Schulze & Burch Biscuit Company’s story is one of big ideas, steady growth and innovative technology. For more than 100 years, we’ve helped bring to market a few of your favorite snacks along the way – saltines, granola bars and toaster pastries, just to name a few. We value ingenuity and ideas, and we believe that the growth, well-being and unique perspectives of our employees make our company better.
about:
Schulze & Burch Biscuit Company operates from Searcy, Arkansas, where it has built a century-long presence in snack manufacturing. While the exact founding year is not disclosed, the company describes a history spanning more than 100 years, rooted in steady growth and technological innovation. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly stated.

The company runs three facilities that produce a range of baked, formed, and blended snack products. Its capabilities cover bars (formed, baked, chewy, crunchy), filled products such as toaster pastries and cereal bars, cookies and crackers made via wire-cut, laminated, extruded, or rotary-molded processes, and cereal ingredients that are blended, coated, or supplied as bases. With over 60 years in contract manufacturing and over 50 years in private label, the operation is geared toward scalable production for brand partners.

Schulze & Burch serves food brands and retailers seeking private-label or contract-manufactured snacks. Its customer base includes companies looking to launch or expand product lines in categories such as granola bars, toaster pastries, saltines, and other baked goods, though specific client names are not disclosed.

The company emphasizes that its quality and food safety systems meet strict global standards and are independently verified. An environmental policy commits the firm to regulatory compliance, pollution prevention, staff training, community communication, and continual improvement in greenhouse-gas emissions, energy, water, and waste reduction.

name: Scotchman Industries Inc
old_description: Congratulations to all at Scotchman for being a tremendous manufacturer of the best metal fabricating equipment.
about:
Scotchman Industries was founded in 1949 in Philip, South Dakota, where it continues to manufacture its full line of metal fabrication equipment. The company is now part of SMX Industrial Solutions, a group that also includes Steelmax Tools and Preston Eastin, broadening its portfolio while maintaining production in its original facility.

The company builds a complete range of American-made machinery for metal fabrication, including 14 models of hydraulic ironworkers from 45 to 150 tons, ferrous and non-ferrous cold saws in manual through fully automatic configurations, pipe notchers (manual, electric, and abrasive), hydraulic presses in 66-, 110-, and 176-ton capacities, measuring systems from manual to full-auto feed, as well as bandsaws, belt sanders, horizontal benders, and conveyor systems. Scotchman also produces tooling, accessories, and replacement parts, and operates an in-house blade sharpening service that typically returns high-speed steel blades within two business days.

Scotchman’s equipment is used by metal fabrication shops, manufacturers, and industrial operations across North America and beyond, as well as by educational programs such as high school welding and fabrication classes. Customers cited on the company’s site include a fabrication shop in Canada and Petty Welding in Knoxville, Tennessee.

Scotchman emphasizes that its ironworkers are 100% American-made and designed for decades of service, highlighting rugged construction, precision, and reliability as core differentiators. The SMX Industrial affiliation adds access to advanced welding mechanization and robotic positioning solutions, allowing the company to offer a more comprehensive fabrication toolkit.

name: Scott Jordan Furniture Inc.
old_description: Founded as a furniture repair shop on Atlantic Avenue, serving the local Brooklyn community.
about:
Scott Jordan Furniture Inc. was founded in 1980 by Scott Jordan as a furniture repair shop on Atlantic Avenue in Brooklyn's Boerum Hill neighborhood. The business began with recaning and reweaving chair seats, furniture repair, and restoration before expanding into custom solid-wood furniture production.

Today the company operates a factory workshop and showroom in the Brooklyn Navy Yard, where it designs and builds heirloom-quality sofa beds, bed frames, mattresses, and cabinetry using a hybrid of CAD/CAM-driven CNC cutting, 3D modeling, and traditional hand-finishing joinery techniques. The in-house team handles custom modifications, delivery, and installation throughout New York City, navigating tight urban spaces such as Manhattan apartments and Brooklyn brownstones.

The firm serves residential clients across the New York metro area and collaborates with upholstery partner American Leather on complex pieces. Its showroom displays over 25 floor models and full fabric libraries, allowing customers to experience materials and finishes firsthand.

Founder Scott Jordan emphasizes non-toxic, sustainable materials—sourcing Pennsylvania cherry, Ohio/Indiana walnut, Appalachian oak, and Eastern Linden from managed forests—and applies hand-rubbed natural oil and wax finishes. The company's manufacturing paradigm shifted to full CAD/CAM in 1999, enabling one-at-a-time production with high customization for NYC interiors.

name: Sdi printex
old_description: SDI was founded in 1985. 2023 is the beginning of our thirty-eighth year. We began designing and decorating sportswear for resorts in the Western United States including the ski areas of Colorado, California and Utah. SDI expanded
about:
SDI Sportswear, based in Salt Lake City, Utah, was founded in 1985 and is now in its thirty-eighth year. The company began by designing and decorating sportswear for ski resorts across the Western United States, including Colorado, California, and Utah.

Today the company operates a full-service art department, a screen-printing facility, and embroidery and appliqué production in-house. Services include custom screen-printed apparel, embroidered garments and accessories, promotional products for trade shows and giveaways, and graphic design and branding support. SDI also produces its own resort and golf sportswear lines and manufactures private-label brands for clients.

SDI serves ski and golf resorts, country clubs, and corporate clients across the United States and Canada. Corporate customers use the company's screen printing and embroidery for event promotion and employee recognition programs, while resorts and clubs source custom sportswear and promotional items.

SDI emphasizes its in-house capabilities as a differentiator: the art department collaborates directly with screen-printing and embroidery production to maintain quality control and shorten lead times. The company highlights over three decades of experience in the decorated-apparel and promotional-products market.

name: Sea Fresh USA, Inc.
old_description: Welcome to Sea Fresh USA, where premium wild-caught seafood meets world-class, fully integrated processing. Since 1981, we have served as the trusted shoreside partner for major house brands, global foodservice distributors, and restaurant chains.
about:
Sea Fresh USA, Inc. was founded in 1981 in North Kingstown, Rhode Island. The company began as a shoreside partner for seafood brands and has since grown into a vertically integrated processor of wild-caught squid and finfish. In 2023, it joined the American Seafood Partners family of brands, expanding its access to vessels, docks, and raw materials.

The company manages the full supply chain from fishing through packing at its BRC-certified facility in North Kingstown. Its dedicated fleet unloads at the Port of Galilee in Narragansett, providing access to a significant portion of Northeast seafood landings. The plant operates year-round, cleaning squid by hand to customer specifications using both blast and contact freezers. Flagship items include Boston Loligo (Doryteuthis pealeii) and Boston Illex (Illex illecebrosus), alongside imported squid species and local finfish.

Sea Fresh serves major house brands, global foodservice distributors, and restaurant chains through private-label and co-packing partnerships. Its private-label expertise spans decades, with the facility packing custom-branded cases for white-label customers across retail and foodservice channels.

The company differentiates itself through vertical integration, MSC-certified sustainable squid, and strict BRC food safety compliance. It emphasizes traceable chain-of-custody and brand protection, positioning its locally caught, locally processed calamari as a premium product for chefs and culinary professionals.

name: Seastrom Manufacturing Co Inc
old_description: Seastrom is the Premier Manufacturer of Precision Washers and Precision Assembly Hardware.
about:
Seastrom Manufacturing Co. Inc. was founded in 1928 in Twin Falls, Idaho. The company began as a manufacturer of precision washers and assembly hardware and has since grown into a full-service washer manufacturer and supplier operating under the Seastrom family of companies, which includes Seastrom Stamping and Acacia Machining.

The company produces precision washers, military hardware, and custom assembly hardware. It operates precision stamping, CNC machining (including 7-axis Swiss CNC with 10,000 rpm spindle), compound and progressive stamping, four-slide stamping, multi-spindle screw machining, and waterjet cutting. It stocks over 60,000 part numbers and offers in-house tool and die, custom packaging, labeling, barcoding, and kitting. The company claims to stock the largest quantity of precision fasteners in the industry, with over 44,000 part numbers.

Seastrom serves aerospace, defense, electronics, communications, energy, medical, agriculture, machinery, and firearms industries. It is an approved supplier for major aerospace and commercial manufacturers.

The company emphasizes short lead times, with most stocked products delivered within 48 hours, and highlights its U.S.-based manufacturing and long history of custom-to-print parts since 1928. It also offers custom engineering to enable manufacturing of new parts to exact specifications.

name: Sechan Electronics
old_description: Defense Electronics Manufacturing for the Department of Defense
about:
Sechan Electronics is headquartered in Lititz, Pennsylvania. The company operates as a 100% employee-owned business through an ESOP structure. No founding year or founders are disclosed in public materials.

The firm provides electronic contract manufacturing services focused on defense applications. Its production capabilities include circuit card assembly, wiring harness fabrication, and end-item integration, supported by automated through-hole component insertion equipment. Sechan also offers electrical, environmental, and EMI/EMC testing, along with design services governed by CMMI Level 3 and ISO 9000 procedures covering project planning, inventory control, integration, verification, and validation.

Sechan serves the U.S. Department of Defense and its prime contractors exclusively. Customer references include the U.S. Air Force, Army, Navy, and Marine Corps, as well as major primes such as BAE Systems, Boeing, Draper Laboratory, Johnson Controls, L3Harris Technologies, Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Raytheon Technologies, Sierra Nevada Corporation, Textron Systems, and Ultra Electronics.

The company emphasizes three differentiators: it is solely dedicated to DoD work, it positions itself as solution-driven with engineering-heavy support for troubleshooting and circuit analysis, and its employee-ownership model aims to align incentives with customer success. Additional distinguishing factors include resident DCMA personnel, extensive product and data security experience, and high-reliability engineering expertise.

name: Sekisui Kasei USA Inc Tennessee Plant
old_description: Founded in 1959, we have 36 locations globally, 4 in the USA. We are headquartered out of Mt. Pleasant, TN.
about:
Sekisui Kasei USA Inc. operates its Tennessee plant in Mt. Pleasant, part of a global polymer and foam specialist founded in Japan in 1959. The U.S. subsidiary of Sekisui Kasei Co., Ltd. maintains four North American locations among 36 worldwide, with the Mt. Pleasant facility serving as headquarters for its American operations.

The company develops and manufactures polymer materials and finished foam parts using polymerization, extrusion, molding, and foaming technologies. Its product portfolio includes EPS and Piocelan molded foams for automotive lightweighting and impact absorption, ST Gels for healthcare fastening and sensing applications, and Techpolymer spherical polymer particles used as additives in cosmetics, coatings, and films. Custom foam packaging solutions are designed for automotive components, heavy transmissions, and sheet metal parts.

Primary markets include automotive OEMs and tier suppliers seeking lightweight, high-impact absorption parts and transportation packaging for interior, exterior, and heavy components. The company also serves healthcare, medical, and cosmetic manufacturers with ion cross-link gels and microparticle additives, along with producers of home appliances and information technology equipment requiring protective polymer solutions.

Sekisui Kasei emphasizes a collaborative design engineering approach, working directly with customers to develop protective solutions that leverage six decades of foaming technology expertise. Its differentiation rests on unique ion cross-link chemistry, proprietary polymerization for spherical particles, and accumulated logistics data that optimizes packaging density and reduces shipping costs.

name: SemiPack Services Inc
old_description: BGA Reballing, Tape & Reel, Robotic Tinning, and Lead Forming.
about:
SemiPack Services Inc operates from West Melbourne, Florida, where it has served the semiconductor and electronics manufacturing sectors for over a decade. The company was founded to provide specialized electronic manufacturing support services, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company focuses on four core service lines: BGA reballing and restoration, tape and reel packaging, robotic tinning, and trim and form lead processing. Its tape and reel operation maintains an inventory of more than 4,000 component pockets, including hard-to-find configurations, and supports both manual and automated processing. Additional capabilities include XRF material composition testing, product testing, baking, dry packing, and custom pocket design and tooling. SemiPack positions itself as a high-mix low-volume (HMLV) specialist.

Customers span the semiconductor industry, electronics manufacturers, and aerospace and defense contractors. The company's ITAR registration and compliance with GEIA-0006 and IEC TS 62647-4 make it a qualified supplier for defense-related programs. It also serves RoHS-compliant manufacturers requiring tin-lead conversions for legacy processes.

SemiPack emphasizes its large pocket inventory, rapid turnaround on non-standard pockets, and adherence to military and aerospace specifications as key differentiators.
